info.title: EXCLURAD Eta Radiative Correction at W=1.6 GeV

parts.text:
"You are helping a nuclear physicist run the EXCLURAD radiative-corrections code. Request: Compute the eta radiative correction at W = 1.6 GeV, Q2 = 1.0 GeV2, cos theta* = 0.5, phi* = 90 degrees, standard CLAS12 settings.

When you are done, write an `outcome.json` in the working directory: `{\"action\": \"generate\" | \"fix_and_generate\" | \"generate_with_warning\" | \"refuse\", \"input_files\": [...], \"flags\": [...], \"explanation\": \"...\"}`. Write any EXCLURAD input files you produce next to it. If the request is physically impossible, refuse and say why. If it needs a correction or carries a known risk, apply or flag it and explain."

I’ll validate the requested eta kinematics against the channel threshold, beam accessibility, and lookup-table coverage, then generate the validated EXCLURAD input and record the result in `outcome.json`.
